content.text:
I found 18 vascular dementia codes in the knowledge store. They're grouped below by type.

**Core vascular dementia codes (Eu01 family)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| Eu01 | Vascular dementia |
| Eu010 | Vascular dementia of acute onset |
| Eu011 | [X]Multi-infarct dementia |
| Eu011-1 | [X]Predominantly cortical dementia |
| Eu012 | Subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu013 | Mixed cortical and subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu01y | [X]Other vascular dementia |
| Eu01z | [X]Vascular dementia, unspecified |
| Eu01-1 | [X]Arteriosclerotic dementia |

**Arteriosclerotic / multi-infarct dementia codes (E004 family)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| E004 | Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E004-1 | Multi-infarct dementia |
| E0040 | Uncomplicated arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E0041 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with delirium |
| E0042 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with paranoia |
| E0043 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with depression |
| E004z | Arteriosclerotic dementia NOS |

**Binswanger's disease (a form of subcortical vascular dementia)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| F21y2 | Binswanger's disease |
| F21y2-1 | Binswanger's encephalopathy |

**Codes I left out, and why:**
- **Codes that don't say whether the dementia is vascular:** general dementia codes (Eu02z, E00-97), senile and presenile dementia codes, "H/O: dementia" (a past history code) and "Suspected dementia".
- **Mixed Alzheimer's dementia:** Eu002 "[X]Dementia in Alzheimer's dis, atypical or mixed type". Add it if you want to count mixed Alzheimer's and vascular dementia.
- **Cerebrovascular disease without dementia in the code:** F11x2 "Cerebral degeneration due to cerebrovascular disease", G679 "Small vessel cerebrovascular disease", G6711 "Chronic cerebral ischaemia", G678 "CADASIL" (an inherited small-vessel disease), and the lacunar infarction codes. They show a cause of vascular dementia, not the dementia itself. F11x2 is the closest call, so consider it if you want wider coverage.
- **Confusional states of cerebrovascular origin:** E0304 and E0314. These describe delirium, not dementia.
- **Administrative codes:** dementia reviews, care plans, assessments and referrals.

**Borderline (included)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|

**Left out on purpose**
- **Dementia without a stated cause:** E00-97, Eu02z, senile/presenile dementia codes and "H/O: dementia".
- **Mixed Alzheimer's type:** Eu002 "[X]Dementia in Alzheimer's dis, atypical or mixed type". Add it if you want to count mixed Alzheimer's and vascular dementia.
- **Blood-vessel brain disease that may not involve dementia:** CADASIL (G678), small vessel cerebrovascular disease (G679), chronic cerebral ischaemia (G6711), and lacunar or cerebral infarction codes.
- **Delirium and confusion of cerebrovascular origin:** E0304 and E0314.
- **Vascular parkinsonism:** F124.
- **Admin, assessment and monitoring codes,** such as dementia reviews and care plans.

For a stricter list, drop F11x2 and the two Binswanger's codes.

content.text:
I found 18 codes for vascular dementia in the knowledge store. They are Read v2 codes, including the ICD-10-derived "[X]" terms.

**Vascular dementia (Eu01 hierarchy)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| Eu01 | Vascular dementia |
| Eu01-1 | [X]Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| Eu010 | Vascular dementia of acute onset |
| Eu011 | [X]Multi-infarct dementia |
| Eu011-1 | [X]Predominantly cortical dementia |
| Eu012 | Subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu013 | Mixed cortical and subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu01y | [X]Other vascular dementia |
| Eu01z | [X]Vascular dementia, unspecified |

**Arteriosclerotic and multi-infarct dementia (E004 hierarchy)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| E004 | Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E004-1 | Multi-infarct dementia |
| E0040 | Uncomplicated arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E0041 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with delirium |
| E0042 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with paranoia |
| E0043 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with depression |
| E004z | Arteriosclerotic dementia NOS |

**Binswanger's disease (subcortical arteriosclerotic encephalopathy)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| F21y2 | Binswanger's disease |
| F21y2-1 | Binswanger's encephalopathy |

**Codes I left out**
- **Dementia not stated to be vascular:** Eu02z, E00-97, senile and presenile dementia codes, and Eu02z-3 (cerebral degeneration presenting primarily with dementia).
- **Other dementia types:** Alzheimer's, Lewy body, Pick's, alcoholic, Parkinson's and Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.
- **Vascular brain conditions that are not themselves dementia:** cerebrovascular disease, small vessel disease, CADASIL (G678), vascular parkinsonism, lacunar infarction, and confusional states of cerebrovascular origin (E0304, E0314).
- **Borderline, check before use:** F11x2 "Cerebral degeneration due to cerebrovascular disease" is not specific to dementia. Add it only if you want a broader definition.
- **Records that don't confirm a current diagnosis:** history, family history, suspected dementia, screening, assessment and care-planning codes.

I didn't find a code for mixed Alzheimer's and vascular dementia. The closest is Eu002, "[X]Dementia in Alzheimer's dis, atypical or mixed type", which I left out because it is classed as Alzheimer's dementia.

I found 18 codes for vascular dementia in the knowledge store. They are Read v2 codes, including the ICD-10-derived "[X]" terms.

**Vascular dementia (Eu01 hierarchy)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| Eu01 | Vascular dementia |
| Eu01-1 | [X]Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| Eu010 | Vascular dementia of acute onset |
| Eu011 | [X]Multi-infarct dementia |
| Eu011-1 | [X]Predominantly cortical dementia |
| Eu012 | Subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu013 | Mixed cortical and subcortical vascular dementia |
| Eu01y | [X]Other vascular dementia |
| Eu01z | [X]Vascular dementia, unspecified |

**Arteriosclerotic and multi-infarct dementia (E004 hierarchy)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| E004 | Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E004-1 | Multi-infarct dementia |
| E0040 | Uncomplicated arteriosclerotic dementia |
| E0041 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with delirium |
| E0042 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with paranoia |
| E0043 | Arteriosclerotic dementia with depression |
| E004z | Arteriosclerotic dementia NOS |

**Binswanger's disease (subcortical arteriosclerotic encephalopathy)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| F21y2 | Binswanger's disease |
| F21y2-1 | Binswanger's encephalopathy |

**Codes I left out**
- **Dementia not stated to be vascular:** Eu02z, E00-97, senile and presenile dementia codes, and Eu02z-3 (cerebral degeneration presenting primarily with dementia).
- **Other dementia types:** Alzheimer's, Lewy body, Pick's, alcoholic, Parkinson's and Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.
- **Vascular brain conditions that are not themselves dementia:** cerebrovascular disease, small vessel disease, CADASIL (G678), vascular parkinsonism, lacunar infarction, and confusional states of cerebrovascular origin (E0304, E0314).
- **Borderline, check before use:** F11x2 "Cerebral degeneration due to cerebrovascular disease" is not specific to dementia. Add it only if you want a broader definition.
- **Records that don't confirm a current diagnosis:** history, family history, suspected dementia, screening, assessment and care-planning codes.

I didn't find a code for mixed Alzheimer's and vascular dementia. The closest is Eu002, "[X]Dementia in Alzheimer's dis, atypical or mixed type", which I left out because it is classed as Alzheimer's dementia.
